items.title: Demna Gives A Lesson In Sex Education At Gucci Fall/Winter 2026
items.summary: Singapore edition of Harper's Bazaar reviews Demna's runway debut for Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 at Milan Fashion Week, describing a body-conscious, sexed-up direction (mini dresses, low-rise trousers, fitted tailoring) that recalibrates rather than reinvents the house archive. The review is largely descriptive/positive on styling but situates the collection within a broader industry debate over whether Demna is truly innovating or repackaging Tom Ford-era Gucci.

items.title: Demna's Runway Debut at Gucci Was 'More Good Than Bad,' Says Bernstein
items.summary: WWD reports Bernstein luxury analyst Luca Solca's assessment of Demna's first Gucci runway show (Fall/Winter 2026, Milan), scoring the collection 7.6/10 and calling reactions a mixed but net-positive set. Relevant to SEA as regional trade and investor watchers track whether the show supports the Kering turnaround narrative directly affecting APAC/SEA store investment and pricing.

items.title: Gucci Fall 2026 Ready to Wear Runway, Fashion Show & Collection Review
items.summary: WWD's runway review of Demna's Gucci Fall 2026 show at Milan Fashion Week describes a structured, controlled, more defined vision replacing the transitional seasons since Alessandro Michele's exit, with sharper proportions and restrained volumes. Serves as the primary trade-press record that regional SEA press (Harper's Bazaar SG, L'Officiel) is reacting to.
